image_description: A close-up, backlit portrait of an orangutan facing the camera. The subject has long, shaggy reddish-brown fur that is strongly illuminated from behind (rim lighting), creating a halo effect. The face is visible in shadow but shows forward-facing eyes and a broad structure. The background is out of focus, suggesting an enclosure or natural habitat.
